install_steps: curl -s https://api.github.com/repos/nilaoda/N_m3u8DL-RE/releases/latest | grep -o 'https://[^"]*linux_x64[^"]*\.tar\.gz' | head -1 | xargs curl -sSfL -o /tmp/nm3u8.tar.gz && tar xzf /tmp/nm3u8.tar.gz -C ~/.local/bin && chmod +x ~/.local/bin/N_m3u8DL-RE
note: Self-contained .NET single-file binaries per arch in GitHub releases (linux_x64, linux_arm64, osx, win). Optional: install ffmpeg for --mux-after-done and mp4decrypt/mp4box for encrypted output.
